headline: Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave exploitation spreads to 3 outlets; Barracuda ESG due 11-13; OpenSSH SSHole due 11-12

bullets.text: Changed: SecurityWeek confirms threat actors are exploiting Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 (XXE) and Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder CVE-2026-111793, now 3 outlets. Both are in CISA KEV with a federal due date of 11-24.
Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 (auth bypass) and CVE-2026-111560 (OS command injection) are exploited in attacks (4 outlets); KEV due 11-13.
Due 11-12: OpenSSH SSHole CVE-2026-123158 (exploited to breach Linux systems, 4 outlets), GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218.

Microsoft patched 1,259 flaws, including exploited Outlook CVE-2026-124194 that may expose NTLMv2 hashes (KEV due 11-24). Chrome's exploited zero-day CVE-2026-125350 is also due 11-24. Git patched a code-execution flaw in recursive clones.

Still active: N-able keeps hosted N-central offline after dozens of published zero-days; SAP patched four CVSS 10.0 flaws (ICM2SHELL); AhsayCBS CVE-2026-105133/105134 and a Xen Orchestra auth bypass are exploited; France blames Iran for sabotage of refrigeration controllers at ~700 retail sites.

Ransomware and breaches: Vanderbilt is on lockdown after a BYOD-claimed attack (6 outlets); Kinnarps stopped production at three sites; YouHack (7.16M) and SberSpasibo (3.29M) accounts added to Have I Been Pwned; Nitori says 37.6M records stolen. The week ran 1.11x the 90-day average.

actions: Patch Cisco BroadWorks (CVE-2026-20320) and Openwave Webtop (CVE-2026-111793) now and check for compromise; exploitation is confirmed.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (due 11-13) and hunt for compromise.
Patch OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex today; their KEV deadline is 11-12.
Roll out Microsoft's November updates with priority on Outlook CVE-2026-124194, update Chrome, and update Git on build hosts.
Apply SAP's patches for the four CVSS 10.0 flaws, and patch or isolate AhsayCBS and Xen Orchestra servers.
N-central customers: follow N-able's guidance while the hosted service is offline and review remote-access logs.
